preconditions.description: The number of days (m) and stores (n) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s_i <= n-1 for s_i in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:m+1]])
preconditions.description: Each day, Dora buys between 1 and n-1 distinct store indices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= store_idx <= n for day in stdin.splitlines()[1:m+1] for store_idx in map(int, day.split()[1:]))
preconditions.description: All store indices Dora buys from are within the valid range [1, n].

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(day.split()[1:])) == len(day.split()[1:]) for day in stdin.splitlines()[1:m+1])
preconditions.description: Dora buys from distinct store indices each day.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'possible' if any(all(any(a_i > 1 for a_i in a_subset) for a_subset in dora_days) and all(all(a_i == 1 for a_i in swiper_subset) for swiper_subset in swiper_days) else False for a_values in product(*[range(2, 10**6+1) for _ in range(n)])) else stdout.strip() == 'impossible'
postconditions.description: The output is 'possible' if there exist positive integer values for a_i such that for every day, the LCM of Dora's chosen stores' values is strictly greater than the LCM of Swiper's chosen stores' values. Otherwise, output 'impossible'.
